claims.evidence: Only one photo of a skinned console; no PlayStation logo, port layout, or chassis shape visible beneath the Liverpool decal to confirm PS4 identity.
No side or rear profile shown to judge size/model variant.
No controllers visible in the single photo; witness report lists accessories as not shown.
No game discs, cases, or digital library screen shown.
No cables, power adapter, or HDMI shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Underlying console brand/model is hidden by the full-body decal, could be a cheaper or different system than claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear/side with ports and official logo, or a photo with the skin peeled back at a corner.
risks.if_unproven: price as unidentified/generic console, not confirmed PS4

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults.
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on and showing the home screen.

risks.risk: Claimed controllers, games, and accessories may not exist or may be mismatched.
risks.proof: A photo laying out both pads, all 7 games, and cables/adapter together.
risks.if_unproven: price as console only, no accessories

risks.risk: Ports or connectors could be damaged, affecting usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear port cluster.
risks.if_unproven: price assuming port damage until shown otherwise

risks.risk: Decal could be concealing scratches, dents, or prior repairs on the casing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges/corners of the console.
Screenshot of system storage settings or a label photo.
risks.if_unproven: price at base/lowest common storage tier

proof_requests: Photo of the console's rear panel showing ports and any manufacturer label
Photo with a corner of the skin peeled back to confirm underlying brand/model
Video of the console powering on to the home screen
Photo showing both controllers, all 7 games, and included cables/adapter together
Close-up photos of all casing edges and corners
Screenshot of system settings showing storage capacity
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a game console with a custom skin, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-model, no-confirmed-accessories unit pending the proofs listed.
